main_content:
Of these, 61 % are journal articles and 24 % conference reports.

ETH E-Citations provides details on a long-term basis of the academic publications that have originated at ETH Zurich and comprises a total of about 120,000 entries. With this, the platform gives a broad overview over the research activities und results at ETH Zurich.
